Goal
* Please format "X", "Y", "Z" and "W" as [[variables]] only and exclude other words from the formatting.

Input
* Is the variable in Line 1 [[X]] or [[N]]?

Output
* Please delete "N".

Constraints
* Test and Validator 3 violate the constraint on [[X]].

* Test and Validator 4 violate the constraint on [[W]].

Cases
* Some cases are the same. Please revise them so that every test and its validator cover the same scenario, but with slightly different inputs and outputs:

  • Test 3 and Validator 3

  • Test 4 and Validator 4

* Please remove the trailing newline from the input for Test 3.

Thanks.

Note that the plural of "sheep" is "sheep" instead of "sheeps" and I've changed that.

Test 4 still violates the constraint on [[W]]. Please fix the case or the constraint.

Thanks.

Good catch !
Done for W.
